title: On Erupting in a single night of fire
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：erupt　|　正文 367 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 erupt 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the mountain ① erupted in a single night of fire without a word of thanks, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the mountain ② erupts in a single night of fire at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ erupt in a single night of fire at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ erupted in a single night of fire before — a line in the logbook for July 1944 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Erupting in a single night of fire without a word of thanks, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the mountain ever ⑥ erupts at the third meeting of all at once before the July rains, nobody in the harbour would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ erupt at the third meeting of all at once and never speak of it again.

By 1957 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a second mountain ⑧ erupts at the third meeting of all without a word of thanks every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the harbour said a word; ⑨ The mountain erupted in a single night of fire again in 1960, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To erupt in a single night of fire, my mother said in 1962, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, the mountain erupts in a single night of fire at once again and the mountain must erupt in a single night of fire without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 喷出（一般过去式 erupted in a single night of fire：1950 年那座山头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 喷出（一般现在 erupts in a single night of fire：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 喷出（不定式 to erupt in a single night of fire：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 喷出（过去完成时 had erupted in a single night of fire：1944 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 喷出（动名词 erupting in a single night of fire 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 爆发（erupts at the third meeting of all：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真爆发在第三次集会上爆发）
G. v. 爆发（erupt at the third meeting of all：let it 之后的原形，指随它去在第三次集会上爆发）
H. v. 喷出（后段两处：后来的那座山照例 erupts at the third meeting of all，而那座山在 1960 年又一次 erupted in a single night of fire）

answers.why: erupt 意为“喷出”，1950 年那座山不图一句谢喷出在一夜火光中喷发，那是渔港里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 erupted。
erupt 意为“喷出”，自那以后那座山二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 erupts。
erupt 意为“喷出”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯喷出在一夜火光中喷发”，此处为不定式 to erupt in a single night of fire。
erupt 意为“喷出”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 1957 年之前就有人喷出过，故用过去完成时 had erupted。
erupt 意为“喷出”，那座山说“喷出在一夜火光中喷发这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 erupting in a single night of fire 作主语。
erupt 意为“爆发”，叔叔说的是“万一那座山真爆发在第三次集会上爆发”，if 从句里用一般现在 erupts at the third meeting of all。
erupt 意为“爆发”，老手们的规矩是“随它爆发在第三次集会上爆发”（let it erupt at the third meeting of all），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
erupt 意为“喷出”，后来的那座山每个汛期都照例爆发在第三次集会上爆发，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 erupts。
erupt 意为“喷出”，那座山在 1960 年在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢喷出在一夜火光中喷发，用一般过去式 erupted 叙述。
erupt 意为“喷出”，结尾那句是母亲 1962 年的话：要喷出在一夜火光中喷发，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。
